# National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)

> NBER is a private nonprofit organization conducting rigorous economic research and disseminating findings through working papers, books, data archives, and policy analysis since 1920.

NBER maintains one of the world's largest repositories of economic research, featuring working papers from leading economists, public data archives, business cycle dating, and specialized bulletins on health, entrepreneurship, and other economic topics. The organization serves as a critical bridge between academic research and policymaking.

## Key Topics

- Working Papers
- Economic Research
- Health Economics
- Business Cycles
- Policy Analysis
- Research Dissemination
- Entrepreneurship
- Energy Economics
- Environmental Policy
- Taxation
- Immigration
- Video Lectures
- Research Data
- Conference Reports
- Gig Economy

## Research & Publications

- [Working Papers](https://www.nber.org/papers): NBER Working Papers archive with research dissemination and videos
- [Research](https://www.nber.org/research): NBER research papers, publications, and policy research library
- [Books & Chapters](https://www.nber.org/books-and-chapters): NBER books, chapters, and conference reports on economics research
- [Research Topics](https://www.nber.org/research/topics): NBER research topics: taxation, immigration, energy, entrepreneurship

## Data & Research Infrastructure

- [Public Use Data Archive](https://www.nber.org/research/data): NBER public data archive: economic research datasets and repository
- [Boston Research Data Center](https://www.nber.org/research/boston-research-data-center): Boston Census Research Data Center: restricted federal statistical data access
- [Business Cycle Dating](https://www.nber.org/research/business-cycle-dating): Business Cycle Dating Committee: recession/expansion identification

## Video Lectures & Educational Content

- [Videos](https://www.nber.org/research/videos): Economics video lectures including Feldstein Lecture and methods

## Policy Analysis & Bulletins

- [The Digest](https://www.nber.org/digest): NBER Digest: policy analysis and economic research summaries
- [The Reporter](https://www.nber.org/reporter): The Reporter: quarterly periodical on industrial organization research
- [Bulletin on Health](https://www.nber.org/bh): Bulletin on Health: healthcare costs and medical innovation research
- [Bulletin on Entrepreneurship](https://www.nber.org/be): Bulletin on Entrepreneurship: small business lending and credit access
- [Bulletin on Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias](https://www.nber.org/ba): Bulletin on Alzheimer's economics: dementia research and caregiving costs

## Access & Engagement

- [Subscribe](https://www.nber.org/subscribe): Subscribe to NBER Working Paper Series, newsletters, and digital access
- [Home](https://www.nber.org): NBER homepage: private nonprofit org conducting economic research since 1920
- [Media](https://www.nber.org/media): Media contacts and press resources for journalists and researchers

## Optional

- [Bulletin on Retirement and Disability](https://www.nber.org/brd): Retirement and Disability Bulletin archive (final issue published)
- [Bulletin on Aging & Health](https://www.nber.org/bah): Bulletin on Aging & Health archive with retirement and health economics
